brief:
Israeli occupation forces raided several areas in Bethlehem governorate on Saturday evening, Shehab Wire reported. The military operation targeted multiple locations across the West Bank district as part of what Israeli authorities characterized as security operations in the region.

The scale and duration of the incursions remained unclear. Israeli forces have conducted frequent raids throughout the West Bank in recent months, citing security concerns. No immediate reports emerged regarding casualties, arrests, or specific objectives of Saturday's operation in Bethlehem.
